record.question: Under Section 2(h) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, a "complaint" means:
options: Any information relating to the commission of a cognizable offence given to a police officer.
Only a report submitted by a police officer after investigation.

Any allegation made orally or in writing to a Magistrate, with a view to his taking action under this Sanhita, that some person, whether known or unknown, has committed an offence, but does not include a police report.
Any petition filed before a Civil Court.
